integrity: All formulas are exact over integers/rationals. The standalone independent root-enumeration and Walsh–Hadamard program checks widths one through five; mathematical all-width validity comes from the displayed proof, not enumeration. Earlier signed-forest specializations may exist.
scientific_limitations: The edge-incidence kernel counts rooted forests with multiplicity, not unrooted forests. Complete odd-width nullity is an exact multinomial sum rather than a closed elementary expression; the high-degree Fourier zero patterns and sharp positive conditioning are not classified.
title: Parity and degree-two Fourier resonances for rooted forests of \(K_{2,n}\)
